title: Maximum Number of Events That Can Be Attended
summary: Given an array of events with start and end days, determine the maximum number of events you can attend, ensuring you only attend one event at any given day.
statement: Given an array of events with start and end days, determine the maximum number of events you can attend, ensuring you only attend one event at any given day.
constraints: Each event may be attended on one integer day from its inclusive start through end.
Attend at most one event per day and each event at most once.
Return the maximum number of events that can be attended.
hints: Sort events by start day and keep active end days in a min-heap.
On each day, add newly started events and discard expired ones.
Attend the active event ending soonest; jump directly to the next start when the heap is empty.
Replacing any later-ending daily choice with the earliest-ending event cannot reduce future options.
editorial: Sweep days while adding events whose starts have arrived. Expired ends leave the min-heap, and selecting the smallest end preserves maximum room for later events. Empty periods are skipped. The oracle independently explores every event/day assignment with memoized used-event masks on short inputs.

tests.explanation: Attend one event on each of days one, two, and three.
An earliest-ending choice each day permits attending all five events.
